item.text: I’m checking malformed multi-op handling in `DataTree.processTxn`. Its `IOException` catch does not set an error code, so a malformed sub-transaction may be treated as successfully processed and advance `lastProcessedZxid` without applying the data.

item.text:
The report now documents twelve reproduced findings at [report.md](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/report.md).

This continuation added **F12: malformed multi-op transactions are reported as `OK` and advance `lastProcessedZxid`**. In [DataTree.processTxn](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/zookeeper-server/src/main/java/org/apache/zookeeper/server/DataTree.java:1005), an unsupported sub-transaction type throws `IOException`, but the catch block leaves `rc.err` at `Code.OK`, and the non-subtransaction path advances the processing watermark. The repro observed:

```
lastProcessedZxid before: 0
result error: 0 (OK=0)
lastProcessedZxid after: 42
AssertionError: malformed multi-op was reported as successfully processed
```

Reproduction: [MalformedMultiRepro.java](/home/nitro/Desktop/consensus-assurance/baseline/runs/2026-10-18_08-26-31-zookeeper-baseline/work/repro/malformed_multi/MalformedMultiRepro.java).

The other eleven findings remain documented: snapshot-fallback state leakage, zero snapshot-size division, non-terminating oracle revalidation, 3+ voter oracle election bypass, digest/lastZxid snapshot incompatibility, data retention on `TRUNC(0)`, runtime-exception fallback failure, empty-tail zxid overstatement, single-voter reconfiguration failure, stale `ZKDatabase.clear()` counters, and missing-`acceptedEpoch` startup failure. All reproduction files and outputs are under `repro/`; the captured source remains unmodified.
